lines.zh: 我一步一晃地穿过蕨丛
lines.en: I waddle through the ferns
The quills on my back sway as I go
I tramp over the deep leaf litter
The light is good in the birch wood
I walk slowly, my quills arrive first
I keep my nose close to the ground

lines.zh: 我沿着树根，一步一步挪。
lines.en: I shuffle along the tree roots, step by step.
There are enough grubs on this grass
I stop and listen for a moment
I walk around the fallen tree
The autumn berries will ripen soon
I do not walk fast, but I walk sure
I huddle there like a ball of spines
I doze off, quills still up
This wood is quiet
The sun warms my back
I roll over, belly up
I hear something far off
I need not move, my quills speak
I gnaw on a tender twig

lines.zh: 我停下来，闻了闻甜浆果。
lines.en: I stop and sniff for sweet berries.
It itches between my quills
A leaf lands on my back
I tuck in tighter, safer that way
These quills reach you first.

lines.zh: 林子里的味道我都认识
lines.en: I know every smell in this wood
I lie down by the roots to rest
My front paws are very short
I will move once it gets darker

lines.zh: 这么待着，一天就过去了
lines.en: Staying like this, a day slips by
One step closer and my quills find you.
My quills are already raised
You want to touch me, think about it
Is that an apple in your hand?
I am not fierce, only afraid
Two steps back, then we talk
These on my back are not ornaments
Your smell is unfamiliar
I do not know you, stay back
Are you offering me an apple
I give a small huff
Do not come at me from behind
I raise my head and see you clearly

lines.zh: 你的鞋子踩坏了我的草
lines.en: Your boots crushed my grass
This many quills between us is just right
I will not run, I will wait for you to leave
I curl into a ball

lines.zh: 这一下扎得我自己也疼
lines.en: That hurt even through my quills
I huff and shuffle back
A patch of quills flattened
You hit a soft spot
I shudder and lose my footing
My quills bristle; I curl into a ball.
The quills are still there, so I am not afraid
I duck under the roots
I can bear this one
Apple, that is the smell of apple
Put it on the ground, do not hold it up
That one in your hand, I can eat
I am shuffling over slowly
My nose is better than my eyes
Sweet berries are my favorite
Let go first, then I come closer
This does smell good
I will try a bite, just one

lines.zh: 拿苹果的人，可以站近点
lines.en: Someone with an apple may stand closer
You ran into my quills
You are the one hurting, not me
I flinch and every quill spreads
You should walk around me
Will that not teach you
My quill tips are the hardest part
Back off, I do not want to prick again

lines.zh: 我们之间需要更大的空当
lines.en: We need a wider gap between us

lines.zh: 我的背上现在全是竖的
lines.en: Every quill on my back is standing
Your hand is bleeding, and deservedly
In the autumn wood, I look for a mate
I must confirm with my nose first

lines.zh: 两只刺球靠在一起要小心
lines.en: Two balls of spines must be careful
We circle first, then come close
I know the smell of my own kind
With a mate, winter passes easier
We slowly lay our quills down
We dig a burrow by the roots together
This cannot be rushed
Sleeping back to back, neither pricks the other
I scoop it up in my short paws
This thing is not prickly
I push it under my nose to sniff
I keep only what can be eaten
I press it under some leaves
I paw at it; it pricks my pads.
I carry it, wobbling as I go
What falls to the ground is mine
I take a bite, not bad
Hide it first, eat it slowly
I heard it, right over there
I raise every quill
Something is nearing my burrow
My back is to you, and my quills face you
My quills are thicker than arrows
I do not start it, but I do not back down
This patch is my ground
I give a low huff
I tuck in, ready to prick
You had better go another way
You are still edging forward
The quills on my back harden
I simply stand here without moving
The distance between us is too short
I still have teeth in this mouth
Reach out and I turn my back to you
Do not think slow means easy
My burrow is right behind me
Any closer and there is only pricking
I keep watching your feet
I whip my back around
The quills go into your hand
I spin and put my back to you
This is my only real move
You back away in pain
I nip at your boot
I charge, quills first
Once I prick, I curl up
A quill tip broke off in you
Do not come again after this
I push out of the leaf litter
This wood suits me well
I sniff this tree first
I shake out my quills
A ball of spines appears on the grass
I slowly uncurl
There are plenty of apple trees here
I scratch at a root
Sunlight comes through the birch leaves
I live around here now
I pick the spot under this thick tree
The smells here put me at ease
Fire catches my quill tips and they stink
My quills hit stone in the fall

lines.zh: 水灌进来，刺都贴在身上
lines.en: Water rushes in and my quills plaster down

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀翻，露出肚子
lines.en: The blast flips me and exposes my belly
Something flying lodges between my quills

lines.zh: 那股力量从我刺缝里钻进去
lines.en: That force slips between my quills

lines.zh: 没浆果吃，我连刺都软了
lines.en: No berries, and even my quills soften

lines.zh: 雷打在刺上，我全身发麻
lines.en: Lightning strikes my quills and I go numb

lines.zh: 虚空里没有树根可以躲
lines.en: No roots to hide under in the void
